info.description: Manage queued instructions through the local HTTP service. Set X-Carrie-On to 1 on every request. Supply a UUID when creating an entry. Repeating that UUID returns the existing entry without changing it. Before editing, read the entry's ETag and send it as If-Match. See ARCHITECTURE.md for examples.
info.title: Carrie On

post.description:
Create an entry or return the entry already saved with the supplied UUID.

Repeated requests leave the existing entry unchanged. A UUID cannot be
reused for a different chat. Use PATCH to edit instructions and a new UUID
to enqueue more work.
